content_of_post_to_answer: How can practicing mock tests improve sitting capacity and focus for the actual NEET exam?
answer: Mock tests are not just practice papers; they are simulations that train the mind to sustain effort under exam-like pressure. Many students know the syllabus but lose marks because their focus drops after two hours. Repeated mocks build mental stamina, reveal when concentration breaks, and teach recovery. I have explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. A strong NEET attempt is not only about knowing answers, but staying sharp long enough to find them.
